# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_PUTS_ABOVE_20

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup (PUTS) performs poorly when VIX is below 20, as indicated by the playbook context filters which state VIX below 20 = do not enter puts (market too complacent, premiums too thin, moves fizzle). Currently, this VIX condition is a soft guideline; we hypothesize that enforcing it as a hard filter will remove losing trades on low-VIX days without affecting the three J anchor winners (which occurred on elevated VIX days).

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry filter: for PUT-side entries only, require real-time VIX >= 20.0. If VIX < 20.0, skip the trade. This filter is applied after all other setup triggers fire but before order placement. Uses the same VIX feed as the existing context filter (updated on every bar). No changes to exit logic, position sizing, or other parameters.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap limiting deployment to 3-4 contracts at typical $1.00-$2.00 entry premium.
2. **Sample bias:** Using 16-month OPRA window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with daily resampling; overfit risk mitigated by VIX threshold being principled (per playbook) and not optimized. Sample size: ~1,200 PUT trigger bars pre-filter.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window pending Stage-1 completion)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation pending Stage-1 completion)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/04-like volatility expansion where VIX>=20 fails to predict move (rare; occurs <5% of days)
   - Max drawdown: ~$-1,200 (based on historical PUT-only DD during low-VIX regimes)
   - Blow-up scenario: VIX spike >40 with immediate reversal (stopped by chart-stop primary; premium stop -50% catastrophe cap)
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 J days currently contribute ~100% of edge_capture (3 winners); post-filter concentration expected to decrease as low-VIX losers are removed (target: top-5 < 80% of P&L).
